_comment: Curated publish titles (YouTube title + thumbnail header) per course, keyed by course id. Search-first: what someone would actually type, never 'Course 2'. One entry per course in src/content/index.ts.
setup: Pandas and Jupyter for beginners: your first DataFrame
intro: Learn data science by predicting house prices: what we'll build
select: Pandas loc vs iloc, boolean masks and dates, explained
clean: Data cleaning in pandas: missing values, wrong types, duplicates, outliers
shape: Pandas groupby, pivot tables and merge: joins explained
see: Data visualization in Python: histograms, scatter plots and honest charts
measure: Statistics for data science: bootstrap, confidence intervals, p-values
features: Feature engineering and data leakage with scikit-learn pipelines
model: Linear regression, decision trees and gradient boosting: predicting house prices
trust: Cross-validation, prediction intervals and model explanation in scikit-learn
ship: From Jupyter notebook to Python package, CLI and FastAPI
